items.name: Api
items.description:
This Api restores a few lost Health Points.
Placed on a friend's head, it makes an excellent target. The Api, we mean.

items.name: Superior Health Flask
items.description: This flask restores some Health Points.

items.name: Health Flask
items.description: This flask restores some Health Points.

items.name: Amakna Beer
items.description: As the old paternal saying goes: "Sometimes you drink your drink and sometimes your drink drinks you."

items.name: Incarnam Bread
items.description: Soft of texture, golden of crust and hot out of the oven, this small loaf will increase your Health Points. It's the most popular type of bread and usually the cheapest.

items.name: Borodinsky
items.description: This bread is one of the trickiest to make... It's extremely difficult to remain coherent as the fumes make their inebriating way into your bloodstream and your loaves slowly begin to scream terrifyingly cruel obscenities at you.

items.name: Sesame Seed Bread
items.description: The most daring Kwaks often dress up as bakers to steal crumbs of sesame seed bread with impunity. After a long process of trial and costly error, Kwaks now know to only try this trick on Iop bakers.

items.name: Crispbread
items.description: This bread is rich in protein but completely tasteless. That's just the way it is - you can't have your bread and eat it too, as the bakers say.

items.name: Fougasse
items.description: This bread, cooked to golden perfection with a delicate flour contains no colourings or preservatives, unlike the Royal Jelly.

items.name: Cereal Bread
items.description: This multi-cereal bread contains enough fibre to give a dead man the runs.

items.name: Mantou
items.description: This crustless bread is quite popular with Enutrofs who've lost their dentures.

items.name: Carasau
items.description: This bread is enriched with whole Barley, which makes for a quality product.

items.name: Rolled Oat Bread
items.description: This bread, light and soft in the centre, is ideal for people that Single Mother Nature has endowed with a tiny stomach...

items.name: Rye Bread
items.description: This bread is prepared with Rye Flour, which lends a brown colour to the centre and a delicious, sugary flavour.

items.name: Recall Potion
items.description: This potion will take you back to your last save point.

items.name: Ghetto Raid Potion
items.description: This potion lets you recover energy points.

items.name: Ivory Parchment
items.description:
(Double-click to gain XP.)
Use this scroll to gain XP without putting yourself on the line.

items.name: White Parchment
items.description:
(Double-click to gain XP.)
Use this scroll to gain XP without putting yourself on the line.

items.name: Golden Parchment
items.description:

items.name: Small Strength Scroll
items.description:
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Strength by 1.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Strength is below 25.

items.name: Pouch of Kolossokens
items.description: Use this pouch to earn 1,000 kolossokens.

items.name: Small Intelligence Scroll
items.description:
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your intelligence by 1.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your intelligence is below 25.

items.name: Solid Bread
items.description: Made with Hop, this bread is fatty with a brown centre. Although rich in essential oils, it tastes awful.

items.name: Lumberjack Scroll
items.description: (Double-click to gain XP.)

items.description: (Double-click to gain XP.)

items.description: (Double-click to gain XP.)

items.description: (Double-click to gain XP.)

items.name: Burnt Pie Scroll
items.description: This scroll will teach you the Burnt Pie spell.

effects.formatted: Learns the spell level Irritable Impact

items.name: Release Scroll
items.description: This scroll will teach you the Release spell.

items.name: Grunob's Lightning Strike Scroll
items.description: This scroll will teach you the Grunob's Lightning Strike spell.

items.name: Summoning of Arachnee Scroll
items.description: This scroll will teach you the Summoning of Arachnee spell.

items.name: Golden Brioche
items.description: The recipe for this brioche was standardised by Xavier the Baker himself. He wanted to make a delicious and light brioche. It's more than he could have hoped for...

items.name: Curryless Curry Bread
items.description: A Kwaker Vans prototype. Its flavour and quality are surprising, but so is the smell, unfortunately. You'll never get used to it.

items.name: Expired Potion
items.description:
This potion is expired, but with luck, it might be possible to recover the resources used to make it.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Lemon Shigekax
items.description: Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made lemon-flavoured candy.

items.name: Strawberry Shigekax
items.description: Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made strawberry-flavoured candy.

items.name: Mint Shigekax
items.description: Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made mint-flavoured candy.

items.name: Cherry Shigekax
items.description: Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made cherry-flavoured candy.

items.name: Greenjely
items.description: Despite repulsing more than a few vegetarians, this minty jelly treat is still an Amaknian favourite.

items.name: Redjely
items.description: Despite repulsing more than a few vegetarians, this strawberry jelly treat is still an Amaknian favourite.

items.name: Blujely
items.description: Despite repulsing more than a few vegetarians, this blue jelly treat is still an Amaknian favourite.

items.name: Multijely
items.description: Multijely was banned after children started disappearing soon after eating it. Not long after, they realised the kids were just going to the shop to get more.

items.name: Mini Healing Potion
items.description: This mini potion will make you feel a little better.

items.name: Superior Mini Healing Potion
items.description: This mini potion will make you feel a little better than better.

items.name: Fairy Water
items.description: The fairy water has healing properties similar to those of Eniripsa's blood. No more need to bleed the poor fellows dry.

items.name: Unikron Blood
items.description: This potion faithfully reproduces all the properties of Unikron blood, except immortality. Drink it and you'll be cured!

items.name: The Legend of Crocoburio
items.description: This book relates the story of the notorious Crocoburio.

items.name: The Treechnid Forest
items.description: This book tells the legend of the Treechnid Forest.

items.name: Creating Magic Items for Ninnies
items.description: This book is full of advice for novice Mages. Essential reading.

items.name: Transport Rune
items.description: (This item apparently contains no magic whatsoever)

items.name: The Legend of the Cruncher
items.description: This book relates the journey of the last Human who got to meet the Cruncher.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Break Wind
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Break Wind emote. Use it in moderation as it can be dangerous for you and your friends. Your enemies will want to steer clear of getting in the path of this lethal stuff.

items.name: Dantegoulish Potion
items.description: This magic potion is the only one that can cast magic into the lattice-work leather panties of Captain Chafer...It speaks volumes about the power of such a potion.

items.name: Pahoa Raid Potion
items.description: This potion lets you recover energy points.

items.name: Raid Boole Potion
items.description: This potion lets you recover energy points.

items.name: The Kwismas Gift
items.description: Christmas Bestseller 634. This is essential reading. It's a classic!

items.name: The Fromsky Family
items.description: Second best seller of the winter of 634, this book is already a reference.

items.name: First Christmas
items.description: The odds-on outsider for the beginning of 635, this book has gained a cult following in recent months.

items.name: Field Bread
items.description: This Field Bread feels like a stone in your pocket... and in your belly for that matter. But it has that familiar rustic flavour that any good bread should have.

items.name: City Bread
items.description: This bread will give you the appetite of a bulimic giant. It'll also fill you very, very quickly. These conflicting properties have killed thousands. Don't be next.

items.name: Phoenix Blood
items.description: This phoenix blood can revive a ghost and pep it up with 5,000 energy points.

items.name: Great Phoenix Blood
items.description: This phoenix blood can revive a ghost and pep it up with 10,000 energy points.

items.name: Fried Breaded Fish
items.description: This rectangle is made from fat-free pieces of cubic fish. Its bland taste delights children but it has low nutritional value.

items.name: Fried Igloo Fish
items.description: This incredibly tasty stick is made from the best fat-free pieces of cubic fish. Its taste delights children and it has excellent nutritional value.

items.name: Crab Stick
items.description: Enjoy it everywhere, but be careful not to eat too much...

items.name: Exotic Crab Stick
items.description: Made from Exotic Crab Surimi, this meat tastes disgusting, but is very nutritious.

items.name: Smoked Kittenfish
items.description: Delicately smoked, this Kittenfish makes a marvellous meal. But be careful, as its smell will stick to your clothes for several decades.

items.name: Smoked Tigerfish
items.description: Firmer and more refined than Smoked Kittenfish, this Smoked Tigerfish will delight lovers of fine cuisine.

items.name: Grilled Bass
items.description: Served on top of lettuce, this fish will fill your belly for a little while. It's not the tastiest, though.

items.name: Grawn Fritters
items.description: Everybody likes crunchy Grawn Fritters. The problem is that they quickly become addictive.

items.name: Sliced Gudgeon
items.description: Slices of gudgeon, hard boiled with onions. Quite delightful despite the smell off you for the following few days.

items.name: Ray Wing
items.description: When cooked too quickly in black Bwork butter, this wing releases an eye-watering flavour into the chewing mouth of the muncher. This meal is not a memorable one.

items.name: Small Steamed Carp
items.description: Steam-cooked to retain the flavour, this small carp's flavour will sweep you off your feet!

items.name: Steamed Carp
items.description: Steam-cooked to retain the flavour, this small carp will make you forget all your troubles. Tomorrow's gonna be another day... just enjoy this steamed-carp-flavoured moment!

items.name: Grilled Kralove
items.description:
This Grilled Kralove gives off a strong smell, but it's a true delicacy if you manage to overcome your disgust. 
A small piece of advice... find something long and sharp to eat it with.

items.name: Sautéed Perch
items.description: This fish swam a long way, but failed to make it to the spawning grounds. Still, it's ready to be eaten, even if it is a little bland.

items.name: Sautéed Kittenperch
items.description: This fish swam a long way, and spawned many young in the rivers of Amakna. It's now ready to be eaten, and tastes delicious.

items.name: Smothered Sardine
items.description: You won't feed the family, or even yourself, with this sardine, but it does make an excellent starter. That said, don't eat it on Tholank's feast day – choking is all but guaranteed then.

items.name: Smothered Dark Sardine
items.description: You won't feed the family, or even yourself, with this sardine, but it does make an excellent dessert.

items.name: Grilled Siktrin Bass
items.description: Served on top of lettuce, this fish will fill your belly for a long time. It's absolutely delicious!

items.name: Horror Grawn Fritters
items.description: Everybody likes crunchy Grawn Fritters. With a low calorie content, it would stupid to refuse them.

items.name: Sliced Kiye Gudgeon
items.description: Slices of gudgeon, hard boiled with onions. Quite delightful... And the usual horrible odour is masked by a mysterious scent of fresh flowers too.

items.name: Farle's Ray Wing
items.description: When cooked with care in black Bwork butter, this Farle's Ray Wing releases an incredible flavour into the chewing mouth of the muncher. This meal will truly give you wings.

items.name: Trout Flambé
items.description: If prepared following the exotic and ancestral recipe of the Lenalds, this kind of fish will help rekindle the fire in your belly... provided you can master the recipe, which is very rare indeed.

items.name: Ancestral Trout Flambé
items.description: If prepared following the exotic and ancestral recipe of the Lenalds, this kind of fish will help rekindle the fire in your belly... provided you can master the recipe, which is very rare indeed.

items.name: Stuffed Pike
items.description: Ah, Stuffed Pike. Everyone eats it, but no one knows what's in it. And not trying to find out is a mark of wisdom.

items.name: Stuffed Tupe-Halett Pike
items.description: Ah, Stuffed Pike. Everyone eats it, but no one knows what's in it. And not trying to find out is a mark of wisdom.

items.name: Shark Fin
items.description: This shark wouldn't have the decency to sprinkle you with a few spices before it ate you.

items.name: Open-Market Shark Fin
items.description: This shark wouldn't have the decency to sprinkle you with a few magic spices before it ate you.

items.name: Grilled Unique Kralove
items.description: This Grilled Unique Kralove smells delicious. A cold Kikim Inn Beer, sunshine glinting off the Asse sea, a plateful of Grilled Unique Kralove. Does life get any better than that?

items.name: Feubuk Beer
items.description: This highly alcoholic beer will warm you up just as much as a roaring fireplace.

items.name: Tofu Fritters
items.description: These little pieces of fried bird are a delight to the taste buds. When they reach your stomach, it's a different story altogether.

items.name: Sautéed Kwak
items.description: These little pieces of fried bird are a delight to the taste buds. When they reach your stomach, it's a different story altogether.

items.name: Piwi Salmis
items.description: There's just enough meat for a bite.

items.name: Salted Larva
items.description: Dip the larva into boiling water for a good minute, this will firm up its gummy flesh. Then, sprinkle with salt and you'll have the ideal snack for a picnic.

items.name: Salted Precious Larva
items.description: Dip the larva into boiling water for a good minute, this will firm up its gummy flesh. Then, sprinkle with salt and you'll have the ideal snack for a picnic.

items.name: Insect Croquette
items.description: This appetizer is a real delight. Once you've tasted it, you'll find it hard to concentrate without having a nibble.

items.name: Scaraleaf Ball
items.description: This appetizer is a real delight. Once you've tasted it, you'll find it hard to concentrate without having a nibble.

items.name: Plant Soup
items.description: It's well known: children hate soup. If you want our advice, before serving this soup, make them lay down on the table, strap them down, and put a funnel in their mouths – it will make things much easier.

items.name: Rat Jowl Chunks
items.description: Like a Gobball, roasting a Rat is the only way to remove its bad smell. As a result, the delicate smell from this firm Rat Jowl will have you salivating instead of running away.

items.name: Roast Gobball Leg
items.description: Roasting a Gobball is the only way to remove its bad smell. As a result, the delicate smell from this firm Gobball War Chief leg will have you salivating instead of running away.

items.name: Roast Royal Gobball Leg
items.description: Roasting a Gobball is the only way to remove its bad smell. As a result, the delicate smell from this firm Royal Gobball leg will have you salivating instead of running away.

items.name: Dragomeat Steak
items.description: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Dragomeat steak and chips? Not on your life!

items.name: Dragoemeat Steak
items.description: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Dragoemeat steak and chips? Not on your life!

items.name: Dragosmeat Steak
items.description: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Dragosmeat steak and chips? Not on your life!

items.name: Crocabulia Steak
items.description: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Crocabulia steak and chips? Not on your life!

items.name: Gwilled Wabbit
items.description: Anyone who has tucked into a gwilled Wabbit steak will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

items.name: Smoked Wabbit Jowl
items.description: Anyone who has tucked into a Smoked Wabbit Jowl will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

items.name: Gwilled Wabbit Leg
items.description: Anyone who has tucked into a gwilled Wabbit steak will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

items.name: Gwilled Wa Wabbit
items.description: Anyone who has tucked into a gwilled Wabbit steak will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

items.name: Goblin Andouillette
items.description: It's both cheap meat and an insult.

items.name: Cooked Ham
items.description: Considered to be the most delicious cut of pig meat, Cooked Ham can be eaten... just for the sake of it...

items.name: Pork Roast
items.description: You secretly wish you could make your old mentor suffer the same fate for the years of humiliation he put you through.

items.name: Dragon Pig Roast
items.description: You don't feel any remorse about turning the Dragon Pig into a common roast. You'd consider it more or less the natural order of things.

items.name: Grilled Sirloin Tip
items.description: The traditional recipe consists of grilling this meat in burning sand, but since not everyone has burning sand handy, you can just throw it in the oven. Also, that keeps you from having to wash the meat after cooking it.

items.name: Boowolf Muzzle Vinaigrette
items.description: This salad won't leave you cold. Its unequalled flavour will have you rolling on the floor, crying with pleasure.

items.name: Moowolf Muzzle Vinaigrette
items.description: This salad won't leave you cold. Its unequalled flavour will have you rolling on the floor, crying with pleasure.

items.name: Sautéed Kwakwa
items.description: These little pieces of fried bird are a delight to the taste buds. When they reach your stomach, it's a different story altogether.

items.name: Golden Bread
items.description: This bread has been kneaded with Golden Wheat Flour. Selling it is a good way to get rich...

items.name: Briochette
items.description: This small brioche is made from Hops. This explains the huge surge of energy which overcomes you when you eat it.

items.name: Magic Briochette
items.description: This small brioche is made with Bright Hop Flour. This explains the huge surge of energy which overcomes you when you eat it.

items.name: Crakot
items.description: This type of Bread is made with Storm Flax Flour, which gives it a pleasant lightness and a great taste.

items.name: Resistant Rye Bread
items.description: This bread is prepared with Resistant Rye Flour, which gives it an awful flavour but lends it unique nutritional qualities.

items.name: Candy Cane
items.description: By extracting sugar from sweet barley flour, we obtain this unique magic-flavoured sweetie.

items.name: Gold-Bearing Rolled Oat Bread
items.description: This bread with an uber-soft centre is just perfect.

items.name: Burnt Cat Inn Beer
items.description: This beer looks a little bit too much like Bow Meow pee. Actually, having tasted it, maybe not enough.

items.name: Camouflaging Scroll
items.description: Thanks to this scroll you'll be able to camouflage yourself in the surrounding environment until your next fight. Avoid moving and making strange noises if you don't want to be found.

items.name: Kikim Inn Beer
items.description: Emptying several tankards of this salty beer can have side effects such as telling iffy jokes, starting fights, or retching all over the people sitting next to you. It's therefore best to consume it in moderation if you want to keep a clear head and fresh breath. That said, if your idea of a good time is a general brawl, your best bet will be to buy a round for everyone.

items.name: Atyu Sirvis Inn Beer
items.description: This Morello Cherry Blop-flavoured beer is sometimes called Manoca.

items.name: Bagrutte Inn Beer
items.description: This beer makes you more momentarily more valiant, but be careful. The higher you fly, the farther you fall!

items.name: Woodenglass Inn Beer
items.description: This is a classic beer and it comes in a wonderfully carved tankard. One of the few cases where the container has more value than the content (alongside Iop skulls and the popular press).

items.name: Pinchaut Beer
items.description: This beer is hot which makes it hard to drink in summer. On the other hand, it gives off a pleasant smell of toast, thus making it the ideal beer to drink at breakfast when there's no bread.

items.name: Scrapmetal Beer
items.description: This beer tastes of old iron, which is both unpleasant and revitalising.

items.name: Rasputin Cake
items.description: This cake is delicious, but it can be a bit hard to digest, especially when you add a touch of Scurvion seed.

items.name: Scroll of Bravery
items.description: This parchment increases your Strength. It can be useful when a furious Kaniger charges you.

items.name: Disheartening Scroll
items.description: Use this scroll to reduce the Strength of a single target. This can be useful when a furious Kaniger is charging your enemy.

items.name: Scroll of Suppleness
items.description: This scroll increases your Agility. It can be useful for dodging the Moowolf.

items.name: Scroll of Stiffness
items.description: This scroll reduces the Agility of a single target. Use it to prevent your enemy from escaping a Moowolf attack.

items.name: Secrets of the Squirrel Language
items.description: This dictionary will teach you how to talk with squirrels, or at least how to try...

items.name: Investigation Form 36
items.description: This form is a good way to identify potential suspects of criminal actions.

items.name: Investigation Form 33
items.description:
This form is usually used to make suspects confess their criminal acts. All you have to do now is fill in a fake interview of Oni Tnec.
(Use it on yourself to use it)

items.name: Divorce Force
items.description: These rings can break the sacred bond of marriage.

items.name: Scroll of Knowledge
items.description: This parchment increases your Intelligence. It will help you keep your cool when faced with multiple enemies.

items.name: Scroll of Stupidity
items.description: This parchment reduces the Intelligence of a single target. It can be useful to prevent your enemy from moving when faced with a mob of angry Bworks.

items.name: Scroll of Restraint
items.description: This scroll increases your Wisdom, which is essential when confronting Dark Vlad.

items.name: Scroll of Senility
items.description: This parchment reduces the Wisdom of a single target. It's necessary when your enemy tries to equal Dark Vlad.

items.name: Scroll of Godsend
items.description: This parchment increases your Luck. Will you be lucky enough to find a Tofu in a haystack?

items.name: Scroll of Rotten Luck
items.description: This parchment can reduce the Chance of a single target, which is useful when, for example, your opponent's from the Emerald Isle.

items.name: Small Red Fairywork
items.description: Ideal for small weddings, and perfect for the annual Captain Chafer Panty Party.

items.name: Blood Sniffling Staff
items.description: This staff is possessed by a sniffling spirit. The spirit can be released, and it will rush straight ahead until it runs into an item that has a scent it loves. It will then haunt the person for a while and then go back to the land of the spirits.

items.name: Consolation Candy
items.description: This boiled sweet appears to be slightly past its best-before-date, or might have been stored in a cupboard next to an open can of Bow Meow food, as it has a rather unusual taste. Eating it might stop you crying, for a few minutes at least.

items.name: Ultra-Powerful Red Candy
items.description: This drop will increase your concentration during fights. Unfortunately, it tastes terrible. (DOUBLE-CLICK TO USE. Bonus 20 Wisdom and 10 Prospecting for the 30 next fights.)

items.name: Magic Book
items.description: This book appears to be magic. Very strange.

items.name: Pinchaut Bread
items.description: You get to eat and drink at the same time with this bread.

items.name: Home Potion
items.description: This potion brings you home whenever you want. If you don't have a home, then this potion will taste like wasted money and will teleport you to the place you're standing right now.

items.name: Scroll of Superhuman Reflexes
items.description: This parchment will make you sharper for your next fight.

items.name: Scroll of Subhuman Reflexes
items.description: This parchment will make you a bit inert at one point during the next fight.

items.name: Qui Leure Bread
items.description: Danioul Garnioul the Baker, a jealous rival of Xavier the Baker, came up with this recipe. Since his customers were always making fun of his ridiculous name, he avenged himself by kneading his dough with his bare feet. It's said his sales went through the roof.

items.name: Tahde Bread
items.description: This Bread contains tiny, delicious pieces of meat which look and taste like fowl. And yet, if you bring this bread to your nose, you will smell nothing but Tofu.

items.name: Red Fairywork

items.name: Mushden Ice Cream
items.description: This delightful ice cream is made using traditional methods by the small Mushden farm, whose mission is to make the mushd a basic element in all iced desserts.

items.name: Wayal Cone
items.description: The upper part of this ice cream was inspired by the famous Wa hat.

items.name: Bontarian Ice Cream
items.description: This ice cream, a subtle mixture of fruity flavours, is the result of the 'know-how of angels'. At least, that's what's written on the box.

items.name: Brakmarian Magma
items.description: This ice cream combines both crunchy and sweet ingredients, and 'shows once again why Brakmar is superior'. At least, that's what's written on the box.

items.name: Tofu Lollipop
items.description: This Tofu-flavoured lollipop is a delight for your taste buds, but a cataclysmic nightmare for your breath.

items.name: Trool Lollipop
items.description: A really delightful and endless lollipop. To be eaten with your friends, preferably.

items.name: Tofu Hot Dog
items.description: This fatty sausage will give you enough strength to digest all the other sausages you've eaten.

items.name: Trool Burger
items.description: This impressive burger could feed an army of starving Chafers. To be eaten in moderation. Too much Trool is dangerous for your health.

items.name: Wild Sunflower Chips
items.description: These chips are made from Wild Sunflower stems, and cooked in boiling Wild Sunflower oil for them to feel at home while they're frying.

items.name: Damaged Pair of Scissors
items.description: A pair of damaged scissors, nothing more.

items.name: Mimilk
items.description: Warning! As clearly specified on the package you should never give Mimilk to a young Bow Meow - it will ruin the carpets for sure.

items.name: Filled and Valid Form
items.description: This little form contains the name of a potential candidate for the baker's delivery man job.

items.name: Form to fill
items.description: This form looks like a simple sheet of paper. Get this though - one touch and the paper figures out if the person suits the criteria in the heading! Isn't that nuts?

items.name: Astrub Beer
items.description: A six pack of this classic brew is the only six pack you'll be seeing for a while.

items.name: Filled but invalid Form
items.description: This little form contains the name of a failed candidate for the baker's delivery man job. The small red mark at the bottom indicates that the poor sod didn't have enough Strength or Agility for the job.

items.name: Surprise Bwork Pack
items.description: Opening this pack requires a huge amount of serenity on your part... its contents are sensitive.

items.name: Dofusian Gift
items.description: We won't spoil the surprise and tell you what's inside! Just have fun my friend and don't party too much!

items.name: Minotoball's Balls
items.description: These incredibly big balls are delicious. You'll think there's no end to them, but isn't that a good thing?

items.name: Brakmarian Intercity-Express Potion
items.description: This rice-based potion enables Brakmarians to return to their hometown instantaneously.

items.name: Bontarian Intercity-Express Potion
items.description: This rice-based potion enables Bontarians to return to their hometown instantaneously.

items.name: Full Soul Stone
items.description: This soul stone contains the souls of a group of monsters whose only wish is to come back to life to tear your body to pieces. It can only be used in special arenas, located in big cities.

items.name: Pandaburg
items.description: Pandaburg is a tasty drink which could very slowly make you blind, mute and deaf. How convenient! Pandawas aren't the speedy kind.

items.name: Pandapiler
items.description: According to the erudite Hel Munster, this genuine nectar delights the goddess Pandawa herself, making her completely euphoric. Any true Pandawa should give his Pandapilers away to the venerated goddess.

items.name: Pandapils
items.description: There's an odd old Pandawa custom that demands one toast by wearing a Tofu feather on one's head and singing: "Pandapils, Pandapils, lalalaLAleuh!" And that's by far not the worst...

items.name: Pandalartois
items.description: Pandalartois is a very toxic drink and its consumption (even in moderation) can lead to serious malfunction of the nervous system. But as it tastes good, Pandawas keep on drinking it everyday Pandawa makes.

items.name: Panduff
items.description: Ideal for libations to the goddess provided you perform the following ritual: lie down on the floor, face the statue, drink a mouthful of Panduff, then drink a big gulp, and finally – and most importantly – take a tiny sip of Panduff. Stare intensely into the eyes of the statue of the goddess. After doing this for a few days straight, she will appear to you. If she doesn't, go and see a shaman.

items.name: Panduvel
items.description: Give a Pandawa a fish and he'll eat all day. Teach a Pandawa how to fish and he'll spend his days in a rowing boat drinking Panduvel (old Pandawan saying).

items.name: Pandarium Tremens
items.description: "Pandarium Tremens proves Pandawa's love and her will to make us happy." This prayer of thanks addressed to the goddess is a pledge of peace between all Pandawas.

items.name: Vodkawa
items.description: "The only way to know if that glass of vodkawa will be one too many is to drink it." This ancient Pandawan proverb is behind much merriment (and more than a few unfortunate incidents). It is also the inspiration for some of world-famous musician Jon Lemon's greatest (and not-so-greatest) hits.

items.name: Pandneken
items.description: "It's true that Bwaks have short legs, but there'd be no point making them longer." This is the type of conversation you end up having after consuming Pandneken. That's why Pandawas now prefer to keep it for their libations to Pandawa.

items.name: Milk Chocolate Dofus
items.description: This Dofus has exceptional power: it can make you drool with joy.

items.name: White Chocolate Dofus
items.description: This Dofus has exceptional power: it can make you drool with joy.

items.name: Chocolate Panda
items.description: You think it's the chocolatey taste that makes this treat so special? Try a chocolate Ouassingue and you'll taste the difference.

items.name: Square of Milk Chocolate
items.description: Made with bamboo milk, this chocolate is a delight for kids and grown-ups so.

items.name: Square of White Chocolate
items.description: Are you dreaming of a square of white chocolate, just like the ones you used to know? Here y'are then. Just eat in moderation to avoid getting fat and unhealthy.

items.name: Square of Dark Chocolate
items.description: Directly extracted from cocoa beans, this square of dark chocolate is very tasty. Be careful not to eat too much of it, it'll give you the spotty skin of a 13-year-old, chain-smoking truck-driver.

items.name: The Hymn of the World - Found Fragments I
items.description: Part I of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the erudite Acidrik Gutsplitter and rewritten by the same.

items.name: The Choice of Gods - Found Fragments II
items.description: Part II of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the erudite Acidrik Gutsplitter and rewritten by the same.

items.description: Part V of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the erudite Acidrik Gutsplitter and rewritten by the same.

items.name: Birth of Bolgrot - Found Fragments VI A.
items.description: Additional Part VI of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the erudite Acidrik Gutsplitter and rewritten by the same.

items.name: Tears of a Goddess (part 1) - Found Fragments VII
items.description: Part VII of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the erudite Acidrik Gutsplitter and rewritten by the same.

items.name: Tears of a Goddess (part 2) - Found Fragments VIII
items.description: Part VIII of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the erudite Acidrik Gutsplitter and rewritten by the same.

items.name: Gods and Demons
items.description: Some metaphysical reflections of Acidrik Gutsplitter (extract).

items.name: The Dofus Era - Found Fragments IV
items.description: Part IV of the Fragments of the History of the World found by the erudite Acidrik Gutsplitter and rewritten by the same.

items.name: Xelor's Divine Clock - Found Fragments VI
items.description: Part VI of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the erudite Acidrik Gutsplitter and rewritten by the same.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Point
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Point emote, either to show the way or to tell on cheaters.

items.name: Golden Larva Egg
items.description: As strange as it may seem, these Golden Larva Eggs are not laid by Golden Larvae but by more common sorts – green, orange or even blue. Nature is just full of disappointing surprises.

items.name: Mass Resurrection Potion
items.description: This potion enables you to resurrect all the allies present around you.

items.name: Mass Liberation Potion
items.description: This potion enables you to free the souls of your enemies to send them directly to their cemetery, without giving them a chance to be resurrected.

items.name: Ripate Beer
items.description: This beer is so acidic it can hardly be drunk. Indeed, the acidity gives the pint the shelf-life of an overweight Moskito...

items.name: Foghorn
items.description: This foghorn is essential for calling to your mount to the rescue.

items.name: Snack Whistle
items.description: Have a break in the bosom of nature. Take your Snack Whistle out and your mount will arrive quicker than a Wabbit chasing a Cawwot.

items.name: Wisdom Candy
items.description:
This candy will increase Wisdom by 100 points for 30 fights.
(Warning! You can only use one candy at a time. If your character takes several different candies, their effects will not accumulate.)

items.name: Lucky Candy
items.description:
This candy will increase prospecting by 100 points for 30 fights.
(Warning! You can only use one candy at a time. If your character takes several different candies, their effects will not accumulate.)

items.name: Energy Candy
items.description: This candy will restore some energy if you're running low.

items.name: Hyrkul's Advent
items.description: Domen's Colossal, Immoral, Unusual Annals will send shivers down your spine. Must be read according to prescription. Side effects: cold sweats and bed wetting.

items.name: Compensation Gift
items.description:
To make up for the recent problems that you've encountered, the Ankama team has given you this gift box containing:
- 5 Compensation Wisdom Candies
- 5 Compensation Lucky Candies
- 10 Compensation Energy Candies
- 10 Eniripsa Powders

items.name: Beginner's Manual
items.description: Reminder of the basic principles to master to become a hero, by Ganymede.

items.name: How to Make Friends and Keep Them
items.description: Some advice and tips to make nice and loyal friends, written by Ganymede.

items.name: How to Travel Without Ever Losing Your Way - Volume I
items.description: Wally Elconom wrote this book for adventurers who don't know their compass from their Zaaps.

items.name: How to Become the Perfect Recruit, Brakmarian Edition
items.description: How to align yourself with getting aligned, or rules to follow to live the life of a Militiaman by Ganymede.

items.name: Al Howin's Gift
items.description: Al Howin was the greatest Pumpkwin farmer on the continent. Unfortunately, he was also apprentice to a certain Bwork Magus who was far too interested in arcane knowledge for his own good. In order to win the 'Biggest Pumpkwin Cultivated with Lousy Pig Slurry' contest, Al Howin cheated by enlisting the help of the Bwork Magus, who decided to test a new incantation on the Pumpkwins... As a result of his idiocy, anyone who ate the bewitched fruits at a certain time of year wound up transformed into strange, misshapen creatures for several days... Apparently, the curse even spread to adventurers who got too close to the bewitched creatures. In desperation, the inhabitants of Amakna decided to start wearing Pumpkwins on their heads, hoping that this might somehow save them. The most surprising thing of all is that it seems to work!

items.name: Magic Yellow Balloon
items.description: This balloon can take off with grace and ease. A beauty to behold, it's handmade with genuine tofu feathers, based on the great magus Betsy Krokerr's original recipe.

items.name: Magic Red Balloon
items.description: This balloon can take off with grace and ease. A beauty to behold, it's handmade with genuine strawberry jelly eyelids, based on the great magus Betsy Krokerr's original recipe.

items.name: Bootlicker Potion
items.description:
This highly illegal potion is feared even by the strongest Pandawa warriors. A single gulp and you'll be obsessed with the idea of licking all footwear in sight. 
Students who are worried about their grades often use a similar potion for their teachers. Their breath smells slightly different though.

items.name: Kaniger Steak
items.description: Either hot or cold, this Kaniger steak will satisfy the most voracious of appetites.

items.name: Koalak Steak
items.description: This piece of meat will fill bottomless stomachs to the brim.

items.name: Preserved Crocodyl Gizzards
items.description: This impressive piece of meat is obviously extremely hard to digest. But just as your eyes are always hungrier than your stomach, so your stomach is always bigger than your brain. Fool!

items.name: Filtounga Dish
items.description: Filtounga is a unique dish. Its perfect melange of ingredients lends it a heavenly taste. Serve warm with a dash of cream and a sprig of fresh parsley.

items.name: Vampire Brain
items.description: Always overloaded with fresh globules, a vampire brain sucks in all the red blood cells it can. That's why vampires are so pale. As for Iops, it kind of explains their red feet.

items.name: Mumussel and Fries
items.description: From the depths of the Asse Sea, Mumussels collect kelp and roll it under their armpits. Once the material is shaped like French Fries, they reach the beach to brown them in the sun before eating them.

items.name: Industrial Troofle
items.description: This traditional cake, rolled in Trool droppings, is an old Bwork recipe. Only a Bwork who defeated a Trool with their bare hands is allowed to eat one. And frankly, after surviving that fight, they're probably ready to eat anything.

items.name: Magic Effect Thrower
items.description: This surprising item contains a dark, concentrated magic that some say is highly unstable. No one can predict the effects it may have, but one thing is certain: you shouldn't wait too long before you use it.

items.name: Piwi Egg
items.description: Piwi eggs are a real treat for those who have a sweet tooth! However, they hatch very quickly when they're close to a source of heat. That's why you shouldn't leave it in your pocket or in your mouth for too long! A mini Piwi could come out of its shell when you're just about to swallow. And trust me, having a starving Piwi stuck between your teeth or swimming its way through your intestines is not what you need if you're ticklish.

items.name: Incarnam Lemonade
items.description: This lemonade, made by the gods, is a mixture of water, bubbles, and animal extracts. It invigorates young souls on their arrival in Incarnam. For everyone else, this sparkling, vaguely yellow trash is just about good enough to use when training for burping contests.

items.name: Cuwsed Cawwot
items.description: This appetising Cawwot looks pwetty owdinawy but it stinks of evil fwom 50 paces. Will you wesist the temptation to devouw it?

items.name: Magic Blue Balloon
items.description: This balloon can take off with grace and ease. It's made with blue larva, which was gutted and then inflated by a Trool, based on the great magus Betty Krokerr's original recipe.

items.name: Magic Green Balloon
items.description: This green balloon is what you get when you feed a luigie mushroom to a green larva. The eyes of the larva roll out in the process and are sold to Bworks as appetisers. This balloon inspired the great magus Betsy Krokerr in some of her most famous recipes.

items.name: Candied Chilli
items.description: This candied chilli is as explosive as the strainings from the devil's jockstrap. This mind bending mixture of sugar and fire led one Dragoturkey to a string of controversial victories in the World Dragokart championships before being banned by all major sporting associations. You can use it as a suppository if you need to make a quick exit or as a pill if getting in is your problem.

items.description: This potion has been made from extracts of bulbs that soaked in Kloug mash. The most audacious alchemists use rice flour instead of Kloug mash, which can no longer be found. Even though it might seem impossible, you'll get used to its taste.

Not to be used in moderation if you have a conquering spirit. Warning! You can place a prism only if you clearly display your rank (with the player versus player mode activated), and if you are in an area with no other prisms. items.description: This potion turns you invisible and allows you move without becoming visible.

items.name: Trashouflage Potion
items.description: This magic potion transforms you into a trash can. As soon as you move again, you'll take on your normal appearance.

items.name: Barrouflage Potion
items.description: This magic potion transforms you into a barrel. As soon as you move again, you'll take on your normal appearance.

items.name: Plantouflage Potion
items.description:
This potion will protect you from aggressive monsters.
It turns you into a plant. If you move, you return to your initial appearance.

items.name: Immobile Camouflage Potion
items.description: This potion turns you invisible but if you move, you'll become visible again.

items.name: Liberation Potion
items.description: This potion enables you to free the soul of an enemy, sending him directly to his grave and preventing him from being resurrected.

items.name: Guild Renaming Potion (Mod)
items.description: This potion lets you to rename a guild following a moderator decision.

items.name: Bottle of Greedoburg
items.description: This ultra-powerful mix of alcohol rips out your tongue, scrapes away your palate, burns your oesophagus and causes your stomach to explode before boiling your brain. In other words, it's a drink for real Pandawas. In tiny writing on the base of the bottle you can just about make out the following: "Consumption of alcoholic beverages may cause health problems. Drink in moderation, except when as an offering to the goddess".

items.name: Plate of Scrampi
items.description: This dish perfectly illustrates Donna Kerbabben's favourite saying: "If it ain't for frying, it ain't worth trying".

items.name: Kerbabben Salad
items.description: The name of this salad is a celebration of the day it was first created. It was served for the first time during the dubbing ceremony of the famous Iopette Donna Kerbabben. As with all foods destined for consumption by knights, it is strongly recommended that vegetarians give it a very wide berth.

items.name: Vaulting Rye Bread
items.description: Served at the great Jon Lemon's funeral, the taste and smell of this bread is so revolting that it would wake the dead... or kill the living. Perhaps that explains the singer's many comebacks.

items.name: Playful Claw Fairywork
items.description: When she was living in the Tower of Tough Love, Mily once ordered a huge number of Fairyworks from a famous craftsman to illuminate her garden parties. She still has some left and when she's in a good mood, she gives them out for free.

items.name: Rough Tongue Fairywork
items.description: When she was living in the Tower of Tough Love, Mily once ordered a huge number of fairyworks from a famous craftsman to illuminate her garden parties. She still has some left and when she's in a good mood, she gives them out for free.

items.name: Mily's Beauty Cream
items.description: Mily slaps this cream on her body every morning to keep herself looking young and beautiful. Just try it and the results will amaze you! Make sure you don't get into any fights while you have it on, though - the least effort will leave you looking like an old hag.

items.name: Intre Bread
items.description: This bread is highly prized by the Iop community for its ability to fill warriors with overwhelming courage. The numerous deaths caused by its consumption are proof that it works. Xavier the Baker stopped making it when a company of limp-wristed troubadours terrorised the region for an entire winter.

items.name: Fishy Salad
items.description: Wake up and smell the coffee, or so the saying goes. Well, this salad does not smell of coffee. It smells of fish. Fish and sweaty feet. Do not eat it in front of a rutting Lousy Pig, unless you're a female Lousy pig, that is.

items.description: This soul stone contains the souls of a group of monsters – including at least one archmonster – whose only wish is to come back to life to tear your body to pieces. It can only be used in special arenas located in big cities.

items.name: Gobball-meat Pasty
items.description: You'll need a strong stomach to swallow this pasty. The gobball meat used in it, not always the freshest cut it has to be said, gives it a flavour akin to oysters in chocolate. Bworks go mad for it.

items.name: Treechorn
items.description: If you rub this tiny acorn gently, it will begin to swell, and after a short time, if you rub a little more, the Treechnid trapped inside it will come bursting out.

items.name: Jorbak's Chest
items.description: Jorbak lost his entire fortune, could it be hidden inside this strange trunk? Open it and find out.

items.name: Prancing Chimera Potion
items.description: That'll teach you to drink whatever is put in front of you!

items.name: The Puddlies' Scroll
items.description: As easy to follow as a Wabbit Wecipe, this scroll's text reveals a bewitching secret.

items.name: HmmMmm Potion
items.description: HmmMmm.

items.name: Dofusian Gift
items.description: We won't spoil the surprise and tell you what's inside! Just have fun my friend and don't party too much!

items.name: Kill Coos Shigekax
items.description: Rediscover the flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made candy, which will increase both Prospecting and Wisdom by 100 points for 20 fights.

items.name: How to Travel Without Ever Losing Your Way - Volume II
items.description: Wally Elconom wrote this book for any adventurer who doesn't know their compass from their Zaaps.

items.name: Primitive Potion
items.description: This ethereal potion can only be consumed by the person who finds it. It will strengthen the link between their soul and their body.

items.name: Novice Healing Potion
items.description: This flask once contained a urine sample. Now it contains a potion that'll give you back some HP. Was it washed beforehand? Dare you to find out!

items.name: Novice Bread
items.description: It's bone-dry, you'll break your teeth on it, it smells of unwashed Bwork underpants, but it'll give you back some HP, so stop pulling that face and swallow it down.

items.name: Novice Fish
items.description: If you hit this fish, you'll hear it echo. Hit yourself while you're eating it and you'll transform yourself into a musical instrument.

items.name: Novice Pasty
items.description: Take a small amount of anything indigestible you can find in the country of Amakna, blend it up with some red-hot spices, wrap it in rancid, sweaty pastry, and you'll end up with this nigh-on inedible pasty. Pushed into a young Feca's mouth, it makes a great dummy, though.

items.name: Golden Dragoone Gift
items.description: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

items.name: Larval Healing Potion
items.description: A bubbly, orange liquid that no one would want to drink.

items.name: Cracklerock
items.description:
This polished stone contains a Crackrock who is anything but polished.
It appears that you can only use it near other Cracklers or Crackrocks.

items.name: Catbread
items.description: This bread is amazing! When you bite it, it meows!

items.name: Monster Bread
items.description:
Sometimes, when you eat very stale bread, you might lose a tooth. If you eat this bread, stale or not, you'll lose all of your teeth.
This magical bread may only be eaten in Sufokia Bay.

items.name: Usable Monster Bread
items.description: This one is more tender. Bon appétit!

items.name: Hulkrap Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Klume Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Kloug Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Name Change Potion
items.description: You can use this potion to change your name. No one will remember that you used to be called Xx-Haxor-naruto-killer-feca-xX-pl. A new life, free from teasing and name-calling, awaits you. Finally, you will be someone.

items.name: Colour Change Potion
items.description: Pink hair, mauve socks, fuchsia skin. Mother Nature wasn't kind to you, but now you've finally got the opportunity to change things. Mustard yellow, here you come!

items.name: Sex Change Potion
items.description: This potion, to be drunk directly from the bottle, will allow you to become him if you were her, or to become her if you were him. To be consumed without moderation.

items.name: Manitou Zoth Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Dofus 2.0 Beta Test Dungeon Gift
items.description: You've been given this gift because you spent more time in the DOFUS 2.0 Beta Test dungeons than any other mortal.

items.name: DOFUS 2.0 Collector's Edition Gift
items.description: This set will make a star of you, if you can keep your mouth shut. But don't worry, even if you can't, it'll still impress the inhabitants of Astrub.

items.name: Mr. Scouty's Recall Potion
items.description:
Twice as creamy and twice as unctuous a "classic" recall potion, Mr. Scouty's Recall Potion will allow you to teleport to the Astrub Zaap from anywhere. The potion's double effect ensures you will live long and prosper.
"Mr. Scouty's Recall Potion" is a registered trademark of Keurk & Stok Enterprises.

items.name: Ridiculous Kwismas Gift
items.description: Not all Kwismas gifts are the same size. Timid adventurers only get ridiculous gifts, as well as the right to be teased or burst into tears.

items.name: Incredible Kwismas Gift
items.description: Whoever gave you this gift is clearly very pretentious. They thought it contained something incredible.

items.name: Potentially Ultra-Powerful Kwismas Gift
items.description: If you believe what's written on the label, this gift has potential. However, as any experienced adventurer will tell you - never trust what's written on the label.

items.name: Plunder Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Larva Brain
items.description: You'd need to be really desperate to eat this. No, don't do it!

items.name: Wefweshing Potion
items.description: The sweetness of a Cawwot, the freshness of a Dragoturkey marathon runner. There's nothing better for getting you back on your feet. Good health, up the empire, cheers!

items.name: Potion: Destination Unknown
items.description: Your instinct tells you not to swallow the contents of this jar. Not just your instincts, either. Your nose, too. The mixture smells like a centenarian Bwork's armpit.

items.name: Festive Fairywork
items.description: PAR-TAY! PAR-TAY! PAR-TAY!

items.name: Phong Huss Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Ektope Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Sack of Snowdrops
items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Snowdrops.

items.name: Sack of Icefish
items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Icefish.

items.name: Sack of Aspen Wood
items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Aspen Wood.

items.name: Sack of Frosteez
items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Frosteez.

items.name: Sack of Obsidian
items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Obsidian.

items.name: Uridnac
items.description:
This little fish is very fond of people and attaches itself to them easily.
However, its biological rhythm is peculiar: it is only active in the month of Aperirel when Silouate warms the fresh water where the fish thrives.

items.name: Vibrating Pingwin Feather
items.description: Following the example set by the Royal Tofu, certain Pingwins grow a vibrating feather that is chock-full of magic. As for its usefulness...

items.name: Apewicube
items.description: There's something trapped in this cube of ice cut from Frigost's Frozen Lake. You've got two options if you want to find out what it is: wait until the ice melts, or, like any self-respecting brat, hit it until it shatters.

items.name: Izterik Fairywork
items.description: This fairywork produces a pleasant pyrotechnic effect for a few seconds and burns your retinas for the rest of your life.

items.name: Az le Tech's Cursed Treasure
items.description: Az le Tech wanted to trade this treasure for his freedom with the Enutrof conqueror Sétroc. Once in his possession, Sétroc did not keep his word and executed Az le Tech. As he lay dying, he cast a curse that will befall anyone who lays their hands on this treasure.

items.name: Ougicle Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Karotz Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Grouillot Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Kubitus Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Piggy Paupe Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Rapiat Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Friswein
items.description: This drink is very sweet and has the distinction of being made from frozen grapes. This explains its rarity and its unique, refined taste.

items.name: Frigrowka
items.description: Also known as the "Mastogob grass drink", Frigrowka is said to facilitate human contact and address difficult issues. As for Frigostians, they drink it mostly because they like to drink.

items.name: Roast Mastogob Leg
items.description: Any wiry, black, curly hairs you find sticking out of this roast haven't come from the Mastogob, oh no. They belong to your sweetheart.

items.name: Roast Royal Mastogob Leg
items.description: Sink your teeth into this leg and you'll feel like you're biting your mother-in-law. You'll ask for more, though, just you wait and see.

items.name: Cooked Cube of Meat
items.description: Recommended by the militiamen of Frigost, this cube of meat is the perfect thing to get you back on your feet after a difficult fight.

items.name: Grilled Pingwin Flesh
items.description: Just enjoy the gritty crunch, it tastes just like chicken!

items.name: Grilled Royal Pingwin Flesh
items.description: This dish smells of gamey meat and rotten fish, but what did you expect? You were warned not to reheat defrosted food.

items.name: Snowfoux Steak
items.description: Eat this meat at every meal for a month and you'll be fat enough to serve as an appetiser for the YeCh'Ti.

items.name: Tengu Snowfoux Steak
items.description: What doesn't kill you makes your stronger, which you'll be living testament to if you survive the terrible indigestion this meat provokes.

items.name: Adventurer Meat
items.description: Use this meat on the Lonesome Pine Trails to make a starving Sabredon appear.

items.name: Frosteez Bread
items.description: This bread is the staple food of Frigostians, which explains why they've withstood the famine for nearly a century.

items.name: Puffed Frosteez Bread
items.description: This bread is the staple food of Frigostian aristocrats, which explains why their first bowel movement of the day comes earlier than that of their less aristocratic peers.

items.name: Gutrot Potion
items.description: This unpalatable potion will force you to make a crucial choice between drinking it to save your life in agony, or dying but suffering less.

items.name: Raid Rayve Potion
items.description: This potion will carry you away from the spirit realm, and get you back on your feet.

items.name: Starry Potion
items.description: Use this potion to travel to the stars without leaving your house. Certain gullible Frigostians even claim that it brings good luck.

items.name: Icefish Fricassee
items.description: Once you taste it, you won't be able to do without it.

items.name: Frozen Icefish Fricassee
items.description: They say that eating Frozen Icefish makes you smarter. Yet another story told to young Iops to make them eat.

items.name: Royal Mastogob Spiritual Gem
items.description:
Awarded to the victor of a certain number of duels, this gem contains the soul of a monster.
Keep in a cool, dry, dark place, away from strong odours. Shake well before use.

items.name: Royal Pingwin Spiritual Gem
items.description:
Awarded to the victor of a certain number of duels, this gem contains the soul of a monster.
Keep in a cool, dry, dark place, away from strong odours. Shake well before use.

items.name: Barnaby Bundle
items.description: This method of transport is uncomfortable, that's for sure, but it's the only method you've found for crossing the barrier between Barnaby's worlds. (DOUBLE-CLICK to use.)

items.name: Mastogob Black Pudding Pizza
items.description: Even if you don't start eating it for another hundred years, you will finish this pizza well before Rattedaugue has successfully made Gonztipay laugh.

items.name: Hungry Planet Guide - Discover Frigost
items.description: This book is in terrible condition and looks pretty ancient - like its content, for that matter. If you read it, you'll certainly know more about Frigost than your rucksack. Well, if you'd arrived a century earlier, perhaps.

items.name: Memoirs of a Hothead
items.description: An extract of Hazieff Taroun's memoirs.

items.name: Imperial Paté
items.description: This dish, presented as a local speciality, was actually developed by Frigostian restaurateurs after the influx of tourists. Playing on the gullibility of adventurers willing to swallow anything, the Frigostians were able to keep their food supplies intact.

items.name: Slightly Prosperous Humbug
items.description:
Before the big freeze, Laurent Gebleuh was often accompanied by his YeCh'Ti, George. George was sweet, George was cool, but after the big freeze, he became a bit of a pain in the arse. That's why Laurent Gebleuh prefers humbugs to George.
This humbug increases your Prospecting by 25 points for 10 fights.

items.name: Prosperous Humbug
items.description:
Before the big freeze, Laurent Gebleuh was often accompanied by his YeCh'Ti, George. George was sweet, George was cool, but after the big freeze, he became a bit of a pain in the arse. That's why Laurent Gebleuh prefers humbugs to George.
This humbug increases your Prospecting by 50 points for 15 fights.

items.name: Slightly Expert Humbug
items.description:
Before the big freeze, Laurent Gebleuh was often accompanied by his YeCh'Ti, George. George was sweet, George was cool, but after the big freeze, he became a bit of a pain in the arse. That's why Laurent Gebleuh prefers humbugs to George.

This humbug increases your Wisdom by 50 points for 15 fights.

items.name: Sleeping Voracious Chest
items.description: This Voracious Chest is asleep. If you want to find out what it's hiding in its belly, you'll need to wake it up - but you do so entirely at your own risk.

items.name: A Flash of Lightning, a Flashing Scythe
items.description: Song taken from a Collection of Farmers' Songs.

items.name: Eliatrope Fantasy
items.description:
There is almost nothing left of the Eliatrope civilisation.
A few ruins, some petroglyphs, faded memories. Since ancient times, important ceremonies were celebrated with a shower of petals. According to Lyrad the Silent, this ritual dates back to the first Eliatropes who opened their initiation with a rain of Wakfu.

items.name: Bag of Eliatrope Fantasies
items.description: This bag contains plenty of Eliatrope Fantasies.

items.name: On Wakfu
items.description: This rare, unholy book, cursed by many and banned from all the libraries, is supposed to have been written by Lyrad the Silent, a charlatan who lived a very long time ago (and who is supposed to still be alive, from what we've heard). The Gods themselves have forbidden their followers from reading it. Even having it on your person is punishable by terrible penalties.

items.name: Me, Missiz Freezz
items.description: This document reveals a very well-kept secret. Well, very well-kept until today, that is.

items.name: Inferno Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: D for...
items.description: Extract from the Aybeeceedarius Daemonica of Trisboulis. 544 Edition.

items.name: The Day After the Avalanche
items.description: Long John gave you this book to help you understand the history of the village.

items.name: Brockhard Flank Steak with Cream
items.description: This succulent Flank Steak gives off a light aroma of chocolate, which is a great way of getting your kids to eat something other than beef burgers.

items.name: Professor Xa Flank Steak with Cream
items.description: This succulent Flank Steak gives off a light aroma of chocolate, which is a great way of getting your kids to eat something other than beef burgers.

items.name: Smoked Bearbarian Breast
items.description: There's a rumour going round that Frigostian lumberjacks' bad tempers and weight comes from having overeaten this meat, which, rich in calories, formed their basic diet.

items.name: Smoked Celestial Bearbarian Breast
items.description: Larger than those of Samantha Lenald and a lot more appetising, this breast meat will please the most chaste of men.

items.name: Pair of Disposable Rustic Skis
items.description:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the Frigostian Carrier.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

items.name: Pair of Disposable Slippery Skis
items.description:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the Royal Mastogob's Greenhouse.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

items.name: Pair of Disposable Dark Skis
items.description:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the Royal Pingwin's Excavation.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

items.name: Pair of Disposable Supple Skis
items.description:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the entrance of Frigost Village.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

items.name: Let's Go A-Beating in the Woods
items.description: By the lumberjack Baul Punyan.

items.name: Kwismas Gift
items.description: Season's greetings and warm wishes from everyone at Ankama. This gift will make you happier than you've ever been before.

items.name: Rogue Elixir
items.description: A good slug of this and you'll be teleported to the Rogue Temple. Known side effects: hiccups, apparition of in-laws, hair loss, dog breath, untied shoelaces, successive red traffic lights.

items.name: Thwee Kings Gift
items.description: If you don't like this gift, you can always sell it in Astrub.

items.name: Stale Kwismas Log
items.description: The fire that burns in your belly will make short work of this Kwismas Log.

items.name: Wise Rebirth Candy
items.description:
This candy will increase Wisdom by 100 points for 10 fights.
(Please note that you can only use one candy at a time. If you character consumes more than one, their effects will not accumulate)

items.name: Lucky Rebirth Candy
items.description:
This candy will increase prospecting by 100 points for 10 fights.
(Please note that you can only use one candy at a time. If you character consumes more than one, their effects will not accumulate)

items.name: Kwismas Sweet
items.description:
This sweet, which is full of the magic of Kwismas, increases you Prospecting and Wisdom by 30 during 20 fights.
(Remember, you can only use one sweet at a time and if your character eats several, the effects will not be carried over).

items.name: Masqueraider Elixir
items.description: A good slug of this and you'll be teleported to the Masqueraider Temple. Known side effects: hiccups, apparition of in-laws, hair loss, dog breath, untied shoelaces, successive red traffic lights.

items.name: Chocrosis Infecting Agent
items.description: This terrible object will inflict the Chocrosis Curse onto any target of your choice. Make sure you don't use it on yourself!

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Yawn emote. Now everyone will be able to see just how devoted you are to Ancestrotek, the Meridia of Tiredness, every time you open your gob.

items.description: This scroll lets you learn to go where you know you shouldn't, at your own risk. That'll give your friends a cheap laugh.

items.name: The Masqueraider Mystique
items.description: Various information about the Masqueraiders.

items.name: The Greatest Adventure of All Time
items.description: This work is signed by Herdegrize the Mystic.

items.name: Ensafalon Corktail
items.description: Lying on a beach under a palm tree with an Ensafalon Corktail in your hand can make you feel out of this world. Say goodbye to that migraine that's been bothering you!

items.name: Sludgepuppy Corktail
items.description: This Corktail with a hint of lingering wet earth odour is a particular favourite of Enutrofs and earthworms.

items.name: Emachus Corktail
items.description: Invented by Nono the Boombot, this alcohol-free drink is great for children, but we don't advise its consumption by Pandawas.

items.name: Vulkania, Land of Adventure
items.description: This prospectus lists all the activities available on Vulkania Island. Please do not litter. That's not in the list.

items.name: The Legend of Grozilla and Grasmera
items.description: This book sheds light on some of the mysteries surrounding the Lords of Vulkania. Not exactly light bedtime reading if you're prone to nightmares.

items.name: Of Sauroshells and Dreggons
items.description: Written by Dina Tapio, an expert on Vulkanian Dracology, this book gives us an in-depth look at Dreggon reproduction.

items.name: Vulkanian Picnic
items.description: This basket is full of everything you need to have a successful picnic in the forest: a tub of Plimok soup, some mud pies, a tourist season salad and an assortment of dried-up fruit. Once you've finished your feast, you'll be able to take a little nap in the shade of the palm trees! Watch out for those bloody ants who are lurking around though.

items.name: Tourist Survival Rations
items.description: These rations, which have a peculiar taste, are old pieces of bread, soaked in Oilbow Grease before being rolled around the armpits. They keep for a very long time: it's not uncommon for them to survive longer than those who eat them.

items.name: Plimok Soup
items.description: This typically Vulkanian soup is made from a mix of spices, salt crystals and rotten vegetables. Considered out of this World by most mere mortals, it is particularly invigorating to the organism. It is, in fact, so delicious that it is only consumed in small quantities: just one teaspoonful is perfectly adequate for a meal. Swallowing any more could result in uncontrollable spasms which could make you look like a plimok.

items.name: Leecha Tongued Fricassee
items.description: Don't be fooled by appearances: this dish is absolutely delicious. The Leecha Tongue is a somewhat strange looking fish which is strangely reminiscent of a Clementine Boot. The texture of its bitter-sweet flesh is much more digestible than an old sole though.

items.name: How to Become the Perfect Recruit
items.description: How to fall into line without choosing sides, or rules to follow for  a militiaman's life, by Ganymede.

items.name: Crimson Dawn (part 1) - Found Fragments IX
items.description: Volume IX of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the academic, Acidrik Gutsplitter, and rewritten by him.

items.name: Crimson Dawn (part 2) - Found Fragments X
items.description: Volume X of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the academic, Acidrik Gutsplitter, and rewritten by him.

items.name: Esra'Ruoy'Dnim's Invasion
items.description: This work is a copy of one of the royal library's manuscripts. The original text was transcribed by George Segrob the archivist, which means its authenticity is guaranteed.

items.name: Chocolate Pricky
items.description: Always dreamt of having your own hearty coat of resin and pine needles to protect against the cold? Eat this chocolate and your wish might come true!

items.name: Chocolate Gift Package
items.description: Always dreamt of bursting out of a huge present during an important function, wearing nothing but a Boowolf Thong? Eat this chocolate and your wish might come true!

items.name: Chocolate Soft Toy
items.description: Always dreamt of being snuggled all day long and to have itchy, synthetic hairs growing all over you? Eat this chocolate and your wish might come true!

items.name: Ice Sugar Snowman
items.description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Snowman. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

items.name: Ice Sugar Wintry Kaniger
items.description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Wintry Kaniger. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

items.name: Ice Sugar Snow Yiti
items.description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Snow Yiti. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

items.name: Ice Sugar Mini Inuit
items.description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Mini Inuit. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

items.name: Gingerbread Sleigh
items.description: Eating this baked delight will really get you into the Kwismas spirit: you'll suddenly be surrounded by snow, you'll be somewhat stouter than before and you'll become diabetic.

items.name: Snowboole
items.description: This fairywork is very easy to use: just aim for a friend's face, and fire! That should leave them frozen to the spot.

items.name: Snowfall Fairywork
items.description: The perfect fairywork for sending chills up your new friends' spines.

items.name: Rint Relic
items.description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

items.name: Kwismas Log
items.description: The fire that burns in your belly will make short work of this Kwismas Log. Rumour has it that one of the Thwee Kings, Balt Hasaw, loves eating Kwismas Logs.

items.name: Kwismas Star Gift
items.description: Check out this magnificent gift, wrapped in magnificent, starry wrapping paper. Who knows what's inside it? Why, the person who wrapped it, of course, and they wish you a merry Kwismas!

items.name: Scarlet Kwismas Gift
items.description: Check out this magnificent gift, wrapped in magnificent, bright red wrapping paper. Who know's what's inside it? Why, the person who wrapped it, of course, and they wish you a merry Kwismas!

items.name: Snowy Kwismas Gift
items.description: Check out this magnificent gift, with its magnificent, Kwismassy wrapping paper. Who knows what's inside it? Why, the person who wrapped it, of course, and they wish you a merry Kwismas!

items.name: Jim Ger's Roots
items.description: Spending all day talking to adventurers who are each stupider than the last can soften up even the firmest of husbands. Mary uses a root-based recipe discovered by the famous biologist Jim Ger to help Harry stay in shape when he starts slacking off.

items.name: Blank Label
items.description: You can write the name of the person to whom you want to send the gift on this label.

items.name: Wedding Gift
items.description: Open it up, quick!

items.name: Birthday Gift
items.description: Open it up, quick!

items.name: Apology Gift
items.description: Open it up, quick!

items.name: Congratulations Gift
items.description: Open it up, quick!

items.description: Open it up, quick!

items.description: Open it up, quick!

items.description: Open it up, quick!

items.name: Corruption Gift
items.description: Open it up, quick!

items.name: Ribbum Gift
items.description: Open it up, quick!

items.name: Surprise Gift
items.description: Open this unexpected present right away!

items.name: Affection Gift
items.description: Open it up, quick!

items.name: Tenderness Gift
items.description: Open it up, quick!

items.name: White Fleaster Fairywork
items.description: An invaluable item for lifting the atmosphere at those extra-slushy weddings. Also very useful for drowning out the sound of those silly little chuckles the bride tends to let out.

items.name: The Legend of Jeff Stobbs
items.description: Within this collection, you'll find a series of engravings which illustrate one of Herdegrize the Mystic's works. It was printed in Astrub by a highly-respected Goblin. Yes, you heard right; a highly-respected Goblin!

items.name: Blue Fleaster Fairywork
items.description: An invaluable item for lifting the atmosphere at those extra-slushy weddings. Also very useful for drowning out the sound of those silly little chuckles the bride tends to let out.

items.description: An invaluable item for lifting the atmosphere at those extra-slushy weddings. Also very useful for drowning out the sound of those silly little chuckles the bride tends to let out.
